function: Inhibit: high-side FET PACK_P to VB1 (pack and array)
failure_mode: DS1 fails closed in the dispenser; or Q4 drain-source short; or S1N shorted to the frame (PACK_N = GND once DS2 closes)
cause: Contact weld, actuator jam, harness chafe, FET die short
system_effect: One inhibit lost on each source; DS2 and DS3 (pack), DS3 and DS2 pole 2 (array) remain
detection: V-EPS-3 at each integration; VI-LV-04 inhibit monitoring in vibration
compensation: Three independent inhibits (EPS §6.3); 11.7 ms RC filter

failure_mode: DS1 fails open after separation; Q4 open; gate capacitor C84 short; R106, R107 or a W12A wire open
cause: Contamination, FET open, MLCC crack, crimp
system_effect: Bus never powers (pack and array both pass Q4): dead on arrival
compensation: Flown switch type; pre-ship and post-vibration switch test (VI-LV-05)

function: Inhibit: second high-side FET VB1 to VB3; NO contact holds TRK_EN
failure_mode: DS3 fails closed in the dispenser; Q5 short; S3N shorted to the frame
system_effect: One inhibit lost on each source; two remain

failure_mode: DS3 fails open after separation; Q5 open; C85 short; R108, R109 or a W12C wire open
system_effect: Dead on arrival

function: Inhibit: back-to-back low-side FETs in the pack return
failure_mode: DS2 fails closed in the dispenser; Q7 short (discharge no longer blocked) or Q6 short (charge no longer blocked)
cause: Contact weld, actuator jam, FET die short
local_effect: DS2 blocks one or neither direction
system_effect: Pack inhibit lost (one of three); DS1 and DS3 remain
compensation: Three independent inhibits; each FET blocks one direction

item: DS2 pole 1 gate drive (BAT_F, R110, J16, RBF pole A, R111, C86)
failure_mode: DS2 fails open; Q6 or Q7 open; C86 short; R110 or R111 open; a W12B pole-1 wire open, or shorted to the frame (gate drive pulled to GND)
cause: Contact, FET, MLCC crack, harness chafe
local_effect: Q6/Q7 stay off; PACK_N floats; DS1's gate (returned to PACK_N) loses its drive
system_effect: Dead on arrival: the pack cannot discharge and the array cannot pass Q4
compensation: Flown switch type; 10 kΩ at the board end limits a frame short to 1.7 mA but does not keep the drive

function: Third array inhibit: holds TRK_EN low while stowed
failure_mode: Pole 2 fails closed in the dispenser (it shares DS2's actuator: a jam also holds pole 1)
system_effect: Array inhibit from DS2 lost; Q4 (DS1) and Q5 (DS3) remain
detection: V-EPS-3 (Rev D: two of three jumpered)
compensation: DS1, DS3 FETs; pass-through of disabled trackers ≤ 6.16 V is below every converter start

item: TRK_EN clamps: DS3 NO, DS2 NO2 (Rev D), RBF pole B; W12B, W12C, W12D
function: Trackers enabled only when every clamp is open
failure_mode: A clamp held after separation: DS3 NO or DS2 NO2 welded closed; a TRK_EN wire in W12B, W12C or W12D shorted to the frame; RBF pole B shorted; a tracker EN pin shorted to GND
cause: Contact weld, harness chafe against the grounded structure, connector debris
local_effect: TRK_EN low: all four trackers stay off
system_effect: No array power: the pack drains within days; loss of mission
detection: FSW sees VSOLAR present with ISOLAR zero; no hardware or software remedy
compensation: None: the clamp design fails held on a frame short

failure_mode: One tracker runs with EN low
cause: Internal failure of the EN circuit
system_effect: Array TRK_EN inhibit (DS2 pole 2 and DS3 NO together) defeated for that tracker; Q4 and Q5 remain
compensation: Q4, Q5 (two inhibits); residual of fix (a): DS2 pole 2 and DS3's NO act on the same node

item: Pack path: F0A, F0B, F0N (sense board, Rev D), F2, RT1, F3, RS6, a cell, both W1 wires of a pole
function: Pack connection; BAT_F is also the only source of the AFE supply and of DS2's gate drive
failure_mode: Any series element opens
cause: Fuse fatigue or a downstream fault, cell CID trip, PTC crack, shunt open, crimp
local_effect: BAT_F unpowered: the AFE stops and DS2's gate drive (R110 from BAT_F) is lost, so Q6/Q7 open, PACK_N floats and DS1's gate is unreturned
system_effect: Bus dead in sunlight too: the array cannot pass Q4. EPS §5.2 and §6.1 say the spacecraft runs on the array after a pack loss; the netlist does not allow it
detection: VBATT_SNS, pack gauge (before the loss); then silent
compensation: None. With SMA-B01: sunlit-only operation (beacon and telecommand in sunlight), still Category 2

item: Secondary protector U2 (BQ771806), Q16, F3 (battery sense board from EPS F, BATTERY_DESIGN 2.9)
failure_mode: F3 fired without an overcharge: U2 output spurious, Q16 short, OVP_G node bridged, or an open cell tap (BF-HAR-01)
cause: Part failure, contamination; an open U2 tap on the sense board (its own taps since EPS F, no ladder); F3 carrying below its −10 °C rating in the first orbit after a cold soak (V-EPS-8)
system_effect: As BF-EPS-10: pack lost and, through BAT_F, the bus dark in sunlight
detection: F1/F3 state not read for F3; pack current zero

item: Pack fuses F0A, F0B, F0N, F2
failure_mode: A fuse fails to clear (rating not as assumed, lot defect)
local_effect: Fault current continues in that loop
system_effect: External short: the other fuses and, downstream of the AFE FETs, SCD/OCD remain. For a W1 short the positive-leg fuses are diverse parts (F0A FM12A72V5.0A by AEM, F0B FM08A125V5A by Littelfuse, EPS E): with F0N, three interrupters, 2-FT (decision C-16; SQSO-BSA-001 H3b), plus DS2 at launch
compensation: FM12 1000 A and FM08 300 A interrupt against ≤ 211 A; diverse parts in BAT_TOP; X-ray and resistance lot acceptance; fix (b)

failure_mode: AFE dead, latched up or in a spurious permanent fail with both FETs open
cause: SEL, part failure, OTP or RAM-shadow upset
local_effect: Pack isolated from PACK_P; BAT_F stays live, so DS2 holds
system_effect: Bus from the array in sunlight only (EPS §5.2); OBC reset and RTC lost every eclipse; no further success level
detection: Pack current zero; AFE status via the EPS controller
compensation: Array-only path (not demonstrated with the transmitter keyed: V-BFM-01)

failure_mode: Both AFE FETs short
system_effect: Overcharge: CV loop and U2 + F3 remain; over-discharge: FSW thresholds, load shed, lockout; short: the fuses

item: AFE SUV detection and FUSE output
function: Sets the recharge lockout on a cell below 2.0 V
failure_mode: Permanent-fail detection or FUSE drive does not act
local_effect: Lockout set only by the EPS controller's LOCK_SET
system_effect: H2 (recharge of an over-discharged pack): FSW thresholds, AFE CUV and the load shed remain; latent

item: Domain crossings: isolator U50, ≥ 100 kΩ crossing resistors
function: Keep GND from reaching PACK_N with DS2 open
failure_mode: Isolation barrier breakdown, or a crossing resistor bridged
system_effect: DS2 bypassed for discharge at launch: one pack inhibit lost
compensation: DS1, DS3 remain; layout gap ≥ 1.0 mm between the domains

item: CV loop (U45A, REF_C, 65.6 k / 10.0 k divider)
failure_mode: Set point high: REF_C high, divider top open, U45A offset
local_effect: Trackers run to their FB clamp (17.08 V)
system_effect: Overcharge: AFE COV (4.25 V/cell) opens the CHG FET; U2 + F3 behind it

item: Charge loops and their supply: U45A (CV), U44 (CC), REF_C, VCTL LDO U40, CC_SET
function: Wired minimum on every tracker's COMP; VCTL also pulls TRK_EN up
failure_mode: A shared loop output stuck low, REF_C lost, VCTL lost (TRK_EN then low), or CC_SET grounded (Q18 short, K1 pole 2 stuck)
cause: Part failure, SEL in U40 (no trip on it)
local_effect: All four trackers held at zero duty or disabled
system_effect: No array power or no charge: the pack drains; loss of mission
detection: ISOLAR zero in sunlight, PERMIT and WIN_OK telemetry
compensation: None: the loops are single string

item: Hardware charge window: NTC1 and its W1 wires (J1-5/-6), U53, U55
failure_mode: Inhibit held: NTC1 or a W1 wire open (reads very cold), U53 output stuck low, U55 stuck high
local_effect: CC set point 0 and CFETOFF for good; no software override
system_effect: The pack is never charged again: it drains to the AFE's CUV, then the bus is sunlit-only (no further success level)
compensation: None. With SMA-B04: an implausible NTC1 reading hands the window to the AFE (NTC2) and the FSW

item: NTC1 60 °C comparator U54B (OT60 to the AFE's BOTHOFF), heater cut-out U54A
failure_mode: NTC1 shorted or reading hot (W1 NTC1 wire shorted to its return)
local_effect: OT60 high: both AFE FETs open; heater cut out; charge inhibited
system_effect: Pack isolated for good: sunlit-only operation

item: Recharge lockout K1 (set path U56, U57, Q28)
function: Latched lockout after a cell below 2.0 V
failure_mode: Lockout set without cause
cause: Shock above the TQ2's 750 m/s² functional rating, a set-path glitch, a controller upset raising LOCK_SET
local_effect: Charging inhibited; the bus runs on the array
system_effect: Recoverable by EPS_CLEAR_LOCKOUT (LOCK_CLR and UNLOCK, SRS-F129) if the receiver and I2C2 work

item: K1 SET coil drive Q28; set OR U56
function: Pulses the SET coil (50 ms one-shot)
failure_mode: Q28 drain-source short, or U56 output stuck high with U57 re-pulsing at every power-up
local_effect: SET coil energised continuously (46.7 mA on 3V3_AO) or re-set at every power-up: the lockout cannot be cleared
system_effect: Permanent charge inhibit: the pack drains, then sunlit-only operation
compensation: None. With SMA-B12 (capacitor-coupled coil drive): one pulse only, clearable

item: K1 RESET coil drive Q29; clear AND U58
function: Clears the lockout only with LOCK_CLR and UNLOCK
failure_mode: Q29 short, or U58 output stuck high
local_effect: RESET coil energised continuously or pulsed at every power-up: the lockout can never hold
system_effect: H2: lockout lost (latent); FSW thresholds, AFE CUV, load shed remain
compensation: Three other H2 controls. SMA-B12 removes the continuous case

failure_mode: Lockout cannot set: SET coil open, Q28 open, U57 dead
system_effect: H2: as BF-EPS-23, latent

failure_mode: Q3 short
local_effect: ≤ 45 mA path around the CHG FET, also when inhibited or locked out
system_effect: Cold charging or recharge of a locked-out pack at up to 45 mA in principle; the CC loop on RS6 (which sees this current) holds the pack current to ≤ 5 mA in sunlight

item: Battery heater SW5, F4, Q22 (40 °C cut-out)
failure_mode: Heater stuck on: SW5 short or HEATER_EN stuck
system_effect: Pack heats; Q22 cut-out at +40 °C, F4 (switch short), AFE OTD at 60 °C

failure_mode: Heater lost: element, F4, Q22 or a W1 heater wire open
system_effect: Pack may fall below 0 °C in cold cases: charge inhibited until warm
compensation: Pack mount conductance keeps it above +1.6 °C in the SIL year

failure_mode: Q22 short
system_effect: H6: SW5 limit, F4, FSW control and AFE OTD remain; latent

failure_mode: Tracker gives no output
cause: Part failure, open inductor or diode
local_effect: Its strings lost (T1, both wing fronts, is the largest)
system_effect: Generation reduced; mission continues with less transponder time

function: Blocks the bus from the switch node
failure_mode: Diode short
local_effect: In sunlight each switch on-time shorts VTRK through the tracker's switch, up to its 5.25 A cycle limit
system_effect: Bus disturbance in sunlight; possible AFE OCD opening the pack; no way to stop one tracker (TRK_EN is shared, the MPPT DAC cannot reach Voc)
compensation: None. With SMA-B17: per-tracker disable by the EPS controller

item: String ideal diode (U90–U97, Q31–Q38), string TVS D1–D8
failure_mode: Ideal-diode FET short or open; TVS short
local_effect: One string lost (open, short) or its body diode conducts (graceful)
system_effect: Generation −1/8 at most

item: 3V3_AO: U15 buck and every unswitched branch (VHW diode, U48, U51, U52, U56–U61, U64, U65, INA228s, U80 A side, REF_A, decoupling)
function: Always-on rail: OBC, radio, EPS controller, RTC, all EPS logic
failure_mode: U15 fails, or any unswitched branch shorts
cause: Part failure, SEL, MLCC flex crack
system_effect: OBC, radio and controller unpowered: loss of mission

failure_mode: Output drifts low (below 3.15 V at the RF board) or out of the supervisor window (3.07–3.53 V)
local_effect: Below 3.15 V the exciter's LMX2571 is outside its supply range; below 3.07 V or above 3.53 V the TPS3850 holds the OBC in reset
system_effect: No transmission (LMX2571 lock lost) or a silent OBC: loss of mission
detection: 3V3_AO voltage (INA3221) in housekeeping, only while the downlink works
compensation: None. SMA-B16: LMX2571 from its own LDO on the PA rail

item: Unfused battery nets: VBAT, PACK_P, VTRK, BAT_F decoupling
failure_mode: A ceramic capacitor shorts
system_effect: AFE SCD/OCD opens the pack (VBAT side) or the fuses open (BAT_F side): bus lost or pack lost
compensation: None. SMA-B15: fail-safe MLCCs (open-mode or series pairs)

failure_mode: No output
system_effect: No transmission: loss of mission

failure_mode: Output high
local_effect: PA supply and the PCM1808 deviation scale rise; SW3 nears its 6.5 V rating
system_effect: Over-deviation (occupied bandwidth) and PA stress
compensation: ADC full scale limits deviation to ±6.3 kHz at 5.0 V, scaling with the rail

function: Hardware TX-OFF and shed of the PA rail
failure_mode: SW3 open or latched, U52 stuck low, RS13 open
system_effect: No transmission: loss of mission

failure_mode: SW3 short or U52 stuck high
local_effect: PA_5V present regardless of RF_TX_EN and SHED_N; both RF-board TX permits follow PA_5V
system_effect: Hardware TX-OFF and the PA shed lost; TX-OFF rests on the FSW refusing frames and on the heartbeat (97.207(b))
detection: Ground TX-OFF test (L1-02); VBUS_SNS with RF_TX_EN low

item: Load shed U48 (comparator, 5 s timer), REF_A
function: Sheds the Jetson and the PA below 13.6 V
failure_mode: Never sheds: SHED_N stuck high, REF_A low, divider bottom open
system_effect: H2: FSW thresholds, AFE CUV and the lockout remain; latent
detection: V-EPS-7 (ground only); SHED_N readback by the controller

item: Load shed U48, REF_A, timer C171
failure_mode: Permanent shed: SHED_N stuck low, REF_A high, divider top open, timer capacitor short
local_effect: SW3 (and SW1, U19) held off with no override
system_effect: No transmitter for the rest of the mission: loss of mission
detection: SHED_N readback (controller) in housekeeping, which cannot be sent
compensation: None. SMA-B05: PA out of the hardware shed, or a commanded override

function: First of two series Jetson switches
failure_mode: SW1 short or U51 stuck high
system_effect: U19 alone controls the rail; the shed acts through U65 (fix (d)); both failed would flatten the pack
compensation: U19 on another port and gate; shed of U19 (Rev D)

item: Jetson eFuse U19 (TPS16630), AND U65 (Rev D)
failure_mode: U19 short, EF_SHDN stuck high, U65 stuck high
system_effect: SW1 alone controls the rail; shed through U51

failure_mode: SW1 or U19 open or latched off; IMON drift
local_effect: Payload unpowered, or the OBC guard trips early or late
system_effect: Jetson experiment lost or curtailed; template beacons continue (D5)
compensation: Fail-graceful design; U19 1.2 A trip independent of IMON

failure_mode: SW2 open or latched
system_effect: No receiver, TNC or exciter: loss of mission

failure_mode: SW2 short
system_effect: Receiver recovery power cycle (SRS-F115) and the RF-silence power removal lost; TX is still gated by SW3 and the FSW
detection: Radio current with RADIO_EN low (cycle test)

failure_mode: SW10 open, or its limit drifted below the OBC's load (reset loop every 0.28 s)
system_effect: Loss of mission

failure_mode: SW10 short (no current limit)
system_effect: Latent: an OBC latch-up then ends the mission

function: MPPT, cell telemetry, lockout backup set and UNLOCK, EOL_KEY (Rev D)
failure_mode: Controller dead or hung without holding the bus
local_effect: DACs high-impedance (MPPT 4.40 V per string), no cell telemetry, no UNLOCK, no EOL_KEY
system_effect: Lockout cannot be cleared; passivation cannot be armed (fix (c) makes EOL depend on the controller): L3-05 lost, ODAR option 2; pack gauge stays on the INA228s
compensation: No protection depends on it (EPS §12); passivation does since Rev D

failure_mode: Controller raises LOCK_SET and then cannot UNLOCK
cause: Hard controller failure with LOCK_SET stuck high
system_effect: Permanent charge inhibit; sunlit-only operation after the pack drains
compensation: None (controller cannot be power-cycled by the OBC)

item: I2C2 devices on 3V3_AO: INA228 U28/U29, controller U37, U80 A side
function: OBC bus to the EPS and the AntS
failure_mode: A device holds SDA or SCL low
cause: Hard I/O failure, SEL (U37 only is on a trip switch, SW9)
system_effect: Before the AntS deployment: the antennas stay stowed, loss of downlink. After it: no gauge, no lockout clear, no EOL_KEY (Category 3)
compensation: Analog VBATT/IBATT lines; bus recovery clears upsets only. SMA-B07

item: AntS buffer U80 (TCA9517), its EN from 3V3_ANTS
function: Isolates the AntS bus while unpowered
failure_mode: Buffer dead, B side stuck, EN open
local_effect: AntS unreachable (a stuck B side is cleared by dropping DEPLOY_EN)
system_effect: Before deployment: antennas stowed, loss of downlink

failure_mode: SW8 open or latched
system_effect: Antennas never deploy: loss of downlink (unless the AntS ICD shows an autonomous deployment)

function: Master arm of SW6 (burn supply) and SW8 (AntS)
failure_mode: Line open or stuck low
cause: Pin damage, resistor open, wire open
local_effect: Neither SW6 nor SW8 can switch on
system_effect: No wing and no antenna deployment: loss of downlink
detection: Deployment telemetry (burn currents zero, AntS NACK)
compensation: None. SMA-B06: AntS supply on its own enable

failure_mode: Line stuck high
system_effect: Burns still need a line edge and the one-shot; AntS idle power

item: Shared burn supply: SW6 (U18), burn buck U17, V_BURN (22 µF, W7 feeds)
failure_mode: SW6 open, U17 no output, or V_BURN shorted (MLCC, a W7 V_BURN wire to the frame)
system_effect: Both wings stowed: transponder lost (L2), wings-failed disposal case; 0.2 % of the 0.29 %

failure_mode: Output high (feedback open: V_BURN toward VBAT)
local_effect: Driver FETs dissipate up to ≈ 9 W for 12 s; 16 V capacitors overstressed
system_effect: A FET or capacitor may fail during a burn; burns may fail

item: Burn channel (×4): one-shot U70–U73, AND U74–U77, OPA2991, FET Q24–Q27, RS20–RS23, resistor, W7 pair
function: One burn resistor at 0.8 A for 12 s
failure_mode: Channel gives no current
system_effect: The same wing's other resistor, on its own line, remains

item: Burn channel FET Q24–Q27, OPA2991, W7 burn return
failure_mode: Driver FET short, amplifier output stuck high, or a burn return wire shorted to the frame
local_effect: Resistor across V_BURN whenever DEPLOY_EN is high (1.0–1.75 A at 7 V), outside the one-shot
system_effect: Uncommanded burning for as long as DEPLOY_EN stays high, including the AntS deployment
detection: Burn current with the line low
compensation: FSW drops DEPLOY_EN; SMA-B06 keeps V_BURN off during the AntS phase

failure_mode: One-shot output stuck high
local_effect: Burn lasts while the line is high
system_effect: Burn duration set by the FSW line timing

failure_mode: A switch fails open, or the SOLAR_SENSE wire or pull-up network opens (reads not deployed)
system_effect: After the attempts the FSW holds IDLE (SRS-F128) until a ground DEPLOY_RETRY; the transponder waits
detection: Generation and string currents show the truth

function: Charge path from the array (VTRK to PACK_P)
failure_mode: F1 opens early
cause: Element fatigue, operation below its −10 °C rating (board AFT −30 °C), over-current
system_effect: Pack drains; spacecraft dark: loss of mission

failure_mode: F1 heater return bridged to GND around both FETs
cause: PCB defect, conductive debris, solder bridge
system_effect: As BF-EPS-61
compensation: Layout: no copper under F1, ≥ 0.3 mm clearance; conformal coat; inspection

item: EOL fire element Q20, EOL_FIRE (PG1, W3-33)
failure_mode: Q20 short or EOL_FIRE stuck high
cause: FET short, pin or software fault
system_effect: Arm latch alone controls F1 (needs EOL_ARM AND EOL_KEY, Rev D)

item: EOL arm element: Q21, latch U61, AND U64 (Rev D)
failure_mode: Q21 short, U61 set by an upset, U64 output stuck high
local_effect: Arm element lost (U64 stuck high: arm needs the OBC edge only, as in Rev C)
system_effect: Fire line alone controls F1
compensation: Fire element Q20; 1 ms RC; 60 s heater time

function: Opens F1 on command at end of life
failure_mode: F1 does not open: heater open, Q20 or Q21 open, U61 cannot set, EOL_KEY not raised (controller), ITV4030 cold
cause: Part failure; or the fire condition of ICD-001 1.6 §4.6 (EPS board ≥ 0 °C by the INA228 die temperatures, in sunlight) never met inside the 24 h attempt deadline: cold season or attitude (EPS orbit minimum −11.5 °C), INA228s unreadable (I2C2)
system_effect: Passivation not achieved: L3-05 lost; ODAR option 2 (controlled energy)
detection: F1_SNS, EOL_STATE (SRS-F111 repeats up to 3 attempts)

function: 1.000 MHz for trackers and bucks (EMC frequency plan)
failure_mode: Clock lost
local_effect: Trackers free-run near 1 MHz; bucks in auto mode
system_effect: Comb lines no longer kept 200 kHz from the uplink windows: telecommand desense possible

function: GSE puts the AFE in SHUTDOWN for storage
failure_mode: UMB_SHUT high in flight
cause: Pickup on the open W11 line, D5 leakage
system_effect: Bus only until eclipse; the AFE wakes on LD at first light: an eclipse reset

failure_mode: Divider or amplifier drift
system_effect: FSW mode thresholds act late or early; the FSW prefers the INA228 when plausible (SRS-F147)

failure_mode: SW11 open, or VBAT_MTQ shorted (auto-retry 40 ms / 1 s)
cause: Part failure, D3 or capacitor short on the OBC
system_effect: No detumble or spin control: tumbling (2.14 W, −11 %)

item: Sensor switch SW4, GNSS switch SW7
failure_mode: Switch open or latched
system_effect: SW4: gyro, magnetometer, sun sensors lost (tumbling, Category 3); SW7: third-party ephemeris (LVR-089)

failure_mode: Latch-up above the SW10 trip
local_effect: SW10 trips and retries after 0.28 s
system_effect: OBC restarts; state in FRAM; RTC keeps time

failure_mode: Micro-latch-up or rail fault below the 130 mA trip, or a hang the watchdogs reset but do not clear

local_effect: OBC stuck, not tripped (OBC §6: not detected by anything)
system_effect: No beacon, no command: loss of mission

failure_mode: Software hang or upset

failure_mode: RESET/WDO stuck low, the NRST 100 nF shorted, or the UV/OV threshold drifted into the 3V3_OBC band

failure_mode: Oscillator stops
local_effect: Clock security falls back to MSI; LSE functions lost

failure_mode: Output stuck low or open
system_effect: No transmission: loss of mission

failure_mode: Output stuck high
system_effect: TX-OFF rests on the FSW refusing frames

failure_mode: Output stuck low or open
system_effect: Loss of mission

failure_mode: One line stuck high
system_effect: The other switch, on another port, controls the rail

failure_mode: No edges: pin stuck, timer stopped
system_effect: No repeat: transponder service lost

function: Stops the heartbeat when the gates close
failure_mode: Lease renewed after the gates close
system_effect: Transponder runs outside its schedule until the next gate pass or a watchdog reset

function: Separation state for the RF silence and the deployment wait
failure_mode: Design disagreement: the FSW configures a pull-up and treats high as stowed (separation_switch.rs); the EPS drives the line high when DS2 is released (R113, 1 MΩ source)
